description: The Charles Schwab Corporation (CSC) is a savings and loan holding company that engages, through its subsidiaries, in wealth management, securities brokerage, banking, asset management, custody and financial advisory services. At December 31, 2025 Schwab had $11.90 trillion in client assets, 38.5 million active brokerage accounts, 5.7 million workplace plan participant accounts and 2.2 million banking accounts. Its principal business subsidiaries include Charles Schwab & Co., Inc., incorporated in 1971 as a securities broker-dealer, Charles Schwab Bank, SSB as its principal banking entity, and Charles Schwab Investment Management, Inc., the investment adviser for Schwab's proprietary mutual funds and exchange-traded funds. On November 6, 2025 Schwab announced a definitive agreement to acquire Forge Global Holdings, Inc., operator of a leading private market platform and trading marketplace, in a transaction valued at approximately $660 million and expected to close in March 2026.
